normalIntro.en: A vacation is literally an emptying of the calendar: the days are cleared and left free.
normalIntro.cn: vacation 字面上就是把日历腾空：日子被清出来，空着。

normal.en: Go on vacation and take a vacation are the two set phrases.
normal.cn: go on vacation 与 take a vacation 是两个固定说法。

normal.en: American English says vacation where British English says holiday.
normal.cn: 美式说 vacation，英式说 holiday。

normal.en: The legal sense survives in court in vacation.
normal.cn: 法律义仍留在 court in vacation 这样的说法里。

normal.en: The root vac- links vacation to vacant and vacancy.
normal.cn: 词根 vac- 把 vacation 与 vacant、vacancy 连起来。

normal.en: Vacationer is mainly American and means a traveller on holiday.
normal.cn: vacationer 主要是美式用法，指度假的游客。

abstract.en: Picture a suitcase half packed at the foot of a bed.
abstract.cn: 想象床脚一只装了一半的箱子。

abstract.en: See a desk calendar with two empty weeks crossed out in yellow.
abstract.cn: 看台历上被黄色涂掉的两个空周。

abstract.en: Hear the click of office lights going off one by one.
abstract.cn: 听办公室的灯一盏盏关掉的声音。

examples.en: We spent our vacation walking in the hills.
examples.cn: 我们假期在山里徒步。

examples.en: She booked two weeks of vacation in August.
examples.cn: 她订了八月两周的休假。

examples.en: The court will sit again after the long vacation.
examples.cn: 法院在长休庭期之后会再次开庭。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「我会开心」——假期一到，我就会开心。

root: 拉丁语 vacare（空着、免于职责）→ vacatio（免除职务、空闲），经古法语 vacation 进入英语

sensesIntro.en: An emptying of duty becomes the free time, then the trip taken in it, then an institution's pause, and in old law a post given up.
sensesIntro.cn: 把职责腾空，先成空出的时间，再成填满它的旅行，再成机构的停歇，旧法里还指让出的职位。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a suitcase half packed on a bed.
core.cn: 核心意象：床上一只装了一半的行李箱。

branches.en: The leaving branch: walking out of the office.
branches.cn: 出发分支：走出办公室。

branches.en: The trip branch: a fortnight on an island.
branches.cn: 旅行分支：在岛上待两周。

branches.en: The court branch: the bench is empty in September.
branches.cn: 法院分支：九月里法官席空着。

branches.en: The old branch: the chair left without a holder.
branches.cn: 旧分支：席位无人担任。

branches.en: The blend: holiday and journey share one noun today.
branches.cn: 融合分支：今天假期与旅程共用一个名词。

intro.en: The Latin root of emptiness plus the noun ending of state: an emptied calendar.
intro.cn: 拉丁语「空」词根加表示状态的名词词尾：被腾空的日历。

latinIntro.en: Vacare, to be free, gives vacatio; the ending -atio becomes English -ation as in creation and relation.
latinIntro.cn: vacare（自由无事）给出 vacatio；词尾 -atio 在英语中变为 -ation，如 creation、relation。

items.example: Vacation is a time left free.
Creation and relation share the ending.
items.exampleCN: creation 与 relation 共用这一词尾。

items.example: Holiday keeps day at the end.

definition_zh: 疫苗；菌苗；防病制剂
definition_en: a preparation given to a person or animal so that the body learns to resist a particular disease
core_image: 一小瓶清亮的液体，装着让身体提前演习的病原体样本
scene: 社区卫生站里，护士从冷藏箱里取出一支针剂，反复核对姓名与日期。The nurse gave the child a vaccine against measles before the family left for the city.
sceneCN: 这里 vaccine 是「疫苗」（第 1 个义项：让人体产生抵抗力的防病制剂）；句意为护士在全家进城前给孩子打了麻疹疫苗。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加动词后缀 -ate 构成，义为「给……接种疫苗」
由 vaccinate 加 -ion 构成，义为「疫苗接种；接种」
由 vaccinate 加 -or 构成，义为「接种员；接种器」
由 vaccine 加 -ology 构成，义为「疫苗学」

senses.title: A preparation that trains the immune system
senses.definition: a substance made from a weakened, killed, or partial germ that teaches the body to fight a specific disease
senses.definitionCN: 由减毒、灭活或部分病原体成分制成的物质，教身体抵抗某种特定疾病
senses.example: The measles vaccine has cut deaths among young children by a huge margin.
senses.exampleCN: 麻疹疫苗大幅降低了幼儿的死亡人数。
senses.why: The vial holds a harmless version of the germ, so the body can rehearse the fight before the real infection arrives.
senses.whyCN: 小瓶里装的是无害化的病原体，身体能在真正的感染到来之前先演习一遍。

senses.title: The germ material itself
senses.definition: the actual weakened, inactivated, or fragmentary germ material used in such a preparation, as studied in the laboratory
senses.definitionCN: 这类制剂中实际使用的减毒、灭活或片段化病原体材料，是实验室研究的对象
senses.example: The team grew the vaccine in eggs, then purified it for the trial.
senses.exampleCN: 团队用鸡蛋培养这种疫苗，再提纯用于试验。
senses.why: At the bench the word points to the material, not the shot: the germ is grown, weakened and measured.
senses.whyCN: 在实验台上，这个词指的是材料而不是那一针：病原体被培养、减毒并计量。

senses.title: The programme that delivers it
senses.definition: the organized effort of giving the preparation to a whole population, often named by the product itself
senses.definitionCN: 把这种制剂给整个人群接种的有组织行动，常直接用产品名来指代
senses.example: The vaccine reached every village in the district within six weeks.
senses.exampleCN: 这场疫苗接种在六周内覆盖了该地区的每个村庄。
senses.why: When millions receive the same dose, the dose becomes the name of the campaign.
senses.whyCN: 当成百万人接种同一剂时，这一剂就成了整个行动的名字。

senses.title: A safeguard against a harmful trend
senses.definition: something that protects a person or society from a harmful idea, habit, or influence, as a vaccine protects from disease
senses.definitionCN: 保护个人或社会免受有害观念、习惯或影响的事物，如同疫苗保护人免受疾病
senses.example: Plain teaching in primary school is the best vaccine against online rumor.
senses.exampleCN: 小学里的常识教育是对抗网络谣言最好的疫苗。
senses.why: The medical image travels: a small controlled dose builds resistance to a much larger threat.
senses.whyCN: 医学意象会迁移：少量可控的剂量，能对更大的威胁产生抵抗力。

intro.en: Vaccine comes from the Latin word for a cow, by way of the cowpox material that Jenner used against smallpox.
intro.cn: vaccine 来自拉丁语中表示「母牛」的词，经由詹纳用来对抗天花的牛痘材料而得名。

items.en: Vacca means cow, and the adjective vaccinus means of or from cows.
items.cn: vacca 意为「母牛」，形容词 vaccinus 意为「牛的、取自牛的」。

items.en: Physicians called cowpox variolae vaccinae, the cowpox of cows, to set it apart from smallpox.
items.cn: 医生把牛痘称作 variolae vaccinae，即「牛的痘」，以区别于天花。

items.en: Jenner published his inquiry into cowpox inoculation in 1798, and the cow-derived material became the model for protection.
items.cn: 詹纳于 1798 年发表关于牛痘接种的探究，这种取自牛的材料成了防病的范本。

items.en: The adjective vaccine, meaning of cowpox, turned into a noun for any preparation of this kind.
items.cn: 意为「牛痘的」的形容词 vaccine 转为名词，指任何这类制剂。

items.en: Laboratory methods replaced the cow as the source, but the name stayed for every trained-immunity product.
items.cn: 实验室方法取代了以牛为来源，但这个名字保留给了所有训练免疫的产品。

note.en: The look-alike group is the cow-derived family, while the near-meaning group gathers other ways of protecting a body from disease.
note.cn: 形近组是「牛」来源的词族；近义组收其他使人免于疾病的办法。

entries.definition: To give a vaccine to a person or animal.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「给……接种疫苗」，由本词加动词后缀构成。

entries.definition: The act or result of giving a vaccine.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「疫苗接种」，由动词加名词后缀构成。

entries.definition: The cowpox virus, the original source material of vaccination.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，指牛痘病毒，是疫苗接种最早的来源材料；同出「牛」词根。

entries.definition: The introduction of a weakened germ into the body, an older word often used for the same act.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「接种」，指把减毒病原体引入体内，是较旧的说法。

entries.definition: The process of making the body immune, of which vaccination is one route.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「免疫」，指使身体获得免疫的过程，接种是其中一种途径。

entries.definition: An extra dose that strengthens the protection already given by a vaccine.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「加强针」，指增强既有免疫保护的一剂。

normalIntro.en: The hooks below use the cow root and the words that grew from it, not a made-up story.
normalIntro.cn: 下面的钩子依据「牛」这个词根及其派生词，不用编造的故事。

normal.en: Vacca is Latin for cow, and the first vaccine material came from a cow.
normal.cn: vacca 是拉丁语的「母牛」，最早的疫苗材料就取自牛。

normal.en: Jenner used cowpox, variolae vaccinae, so the new practice took the cow name.
normal.cn: 詹纳用牛痘「variolae vaccinae」，新的做法因此得了「牛」的名字。

normal.en: Vaccine is the thing, vaccinate is the act, and vaccination is the process.
normal.cn: vaccine 是东西，vaccinate 是动作，vaccination 是过程。

normal.en: A flu vaccine is a seasonal dose, while a booster is an extra dose given later.
normal.cn: flu vaccine 是季节性的一剂；booster 是之后补打的加强一剂。

normal.en: Vaccine hesitancy names the delay or refusal of a vaccine even when it is offered.
normal.cn: vaccine hesitancy 指即使有疫苗也迟疑或拒绝接种。

abstract.en: Picture a vial of clear liquid that holds a harmless copy of a germ.
abstract.cn: 想象一小瓶清亮液体，里面装着无害化的病原体副本。

abstract.en: Picture a lab bench where the germ is grown, weakened and measured before it fills the vial.
abstract.cn: 想象实验台上病原体先被培养、减毒、计量，再灌进小瓶。

abstract.en: Picture a cold box carried from village to village until every arm has had its dose.
abstract.cn: 想象一只冷藏箱从一个村送到另一个村，直到每条胳膊都打过一针。

examples.en: The new vaccine was tested in twelve hospitals before approval.
examples.cn: 新疫苗在获批前于十二家医院接受了测试。

examples.en: Parents were asked to bring the child back for a second vaccine.
examples.cn: 家长被要求带孩子回来接种第二剂疫苗。

examples.en: Health workers carried the vaccine through flooded roads to reach the clinic.
examples.cn: 医护人员带着疫苗穿过被淹的道路抵达诊所。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瓦克辛」——听成「哇，克星」：疫苗一到，病就遇上克星；这只是读音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 vacca（母牛）→ vaccinus（牛的）→ 医学拉丁语 variolae vaccinae（牛痘）→ 英语 vaccine（疫苗）。核心义是「取自牛身上的防病材料」，后来泛指一切训练免疫的制剂。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses run from the vial itself through the germ material and the delivery programme to a figurative safeguard against harmful ideas.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项从小瓶本身，到瓶中的病原体材料，再到送针的接种行动，最后到抵御有害观念的比喻义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a small vial of clear liquid holds a harmless copy of a germ.
core.cn: 核心意象：一小瓶清亮液体里装着一份无害化的病原体副本。

branches.en: THE VIAL: the dose itself teaches the body to resist one disease.
branches.cn: 小瓶线：这一剂本身教身体抵抗某一种病。

branches.en: THE MATERIAL: at the bench the word names the grown and weakened germ.
branches.cn: 材料线：在实验台上，这个词指被培养、减毒的病原体。

branches.en: THE CAMPAIGN: when a whole population is dosed, the product names the programme.
branches.cn: 行动线：当全体人群都接种时，产品名就成了整个计划的名字。

branches.en: THE FIGURE: a small controlled dose of a harmful thing builds resistance to a larger one.
branches.cn: 比喻线：少量可控的有害接触，能对更大的威胁建立抵抗力。

branches.en: The vial and the campaign are the same protection seen at two scales.
branches.cn: 小瓶与接种行动是同一种保护在两个尺度上的样子。

intro.en: Vaccine is a Latin cow word that English turned into a medical family of verbs, nouns and adjectives.
intro.cn: vaccine 本是拉丁语中表示「牛」的词，英语把它扩展成由动词、名词、形容词组成的医学词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin vacca and vaccinus are recorded words; variolae vaccinae is the eighteenth-century medical phrase built on them.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 vacca 与 vaccinus 都是有记录的词；variolae vaccinae 是十八世纪在这两个词基础上构成的医学术语。

items.example: Vacca is the source of the whole family.
items.exampleCN: vacca 是整个词族的来源。

items.example: The adjective describes material taken from a cow.
items.exampleCN: 这个形容词描述取自牛的材料。

items.example: The phrase named the disease that gave the practice its start.
items.exampleCN: 这个短语命名了促使这一做法开始的疾病。

items.example: Vaccinia names the virus used in the first vaccines.
items.exampleCN: vaccinia 指最早疫苗中使用的病毒。

items.example: English keeps the noun for the dose itself.
items.exampleCN: 英语用这个名词指那一剂本身。

items.example: The verb names the act of giving the dose.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词指给人接种这一剂的动作。

items.meaning: the act or result of vaccinating
items.example: The noun of process grew from the verb.
items.exampleCN: 表示过程的名词由动词扩展而来。

definition_zh: 真空；真空吸尘器；空白；用吸尘器清扫
definition_en: a space with no air or matter in it, a machine that cleans by suction, or a gap left empty
core_image: 玻璃罩里的空气被抽干，羽毛和硬币同时落地
scene: 物理课上，老师把羽毛和硬币放进玻璃罩，按下开关，空气嘶嘶被抽走，羽毛和硬币同时落到底。In a vacuum, a feather falls as fast as a coin.
sceneCN: 这里 vacuum 是「真空」（第 1 个义项：没有空气的空间）；句意为在真空里羽毛和硬币下落得一样快。玻璃罩里的空气被抽干，正是这个词的核心。

derivatives.zh: 同根形容词，义为「空洞的；茫然的」
同根名词，义为「空洞；无内容」
同根形容词，义为「空的；空缺的」
同根名词，义为「假期」

senses.title: A space with no air or matter
senses.definition: an enclosed space from which air and other matter have been removed
senses.definitionCN: 被抽去空气与其他物质的封闭空间
senses.example: Sound cannot travel through a vacuum.
senses.exampleCN: 声音无法在真空中传播。
senses.why: The Latin noun meant an empty space, and physics simply kept that exact meaning for a space with nothing in it.
senses.whyCN: 这个拉丁名词本指空旷之处，物理学只是原样保留了这一含义，用来指里面什么都没有的空间。

senses.title: A machine that cleans by suction
senses.definition: an electrical machine that removes dust by sucking air through it
senses.definitionCN: 用抽气的方式把灰尘吸走的电器
senses.example: She ran the vacuum over the carpet twice.
senses.exampleCN: 她用吸尘器把地毯吸了两遍。
senses.why: A cleaner that works by creating a partial vacuum took the name of the emptiness it makes.
senses.whyCN: 一种靠制造局部真空来清扫的机器，干脆用它所造出的「空」来命名。

senses.title: An empty gap left by something missing
senses.definition: a state or place left empty after something important is lost
senses.definitionCN: 重要之物失去后留下的空荡状态或位置
senses.example: Retirement left a vacuum in the team.
senses.exampleCN: 退休在团队里留下了一片空白。
senses.why: If an empty space is the point, then a team missing its leader is an empty space too, and the metaphor needs no change of word.
senses.whyCN: 既然关键在「空出来的位置」，那么失去领头人的团队也是一处空位，比喻连词都不用换。

senses.title: To clean with a suction machine
senses.definition: to clean a floor or a surface with a vacuum cleaner
senses.definitionCN: 用吸尘器清洁地面或表面
senses.example: He vacuums the stairs every Saturday morning.
senses.exampleCN: 他每周六早上用吸尘器吸楼梯。
senses.why: The noun naming the machine turns into a verb once people start doing the job with it.
senses.whyCN: 一旦人们用这台机器干活，称呼机器的名词就变成了动词。

senses.title: In isolation from real conditions
senses.definition: in the phrase in a vacuum, meaning without any surrounding influence or context
senses.definitionCN: 用于 in a vacuum，指没有任何周围影响或情境
senses.example: No plan is made in a vacuum; every room has a budget.
senses.exampleCN: 任何计划都不是凭空定下的，每间屋子都有预算。
senses.why: A physical vacuum has no surroundings at all, and thinking with no surroundings borrowed the same picture.
senses.whyCN: 物理真空周围什么也没有，没有周围环境可言的思考便借用了同一幅画面。

intro.en: A Latin noun of emptiness borrowed whole; physics, the home, and the office each took it over.
intro.cn: 一个整体借入的拉丁语「空」名词；物理学、家务与办公室各自把它拿去用了。

items.en: Vacuum was the neuter of vacuus, empty, and meant an empty space.
items.cn: vacuum 是 vacuus（空的）的中性形式，意为空旷之处。

items.en: Writers on natural philosophy used the word for a space with no air in it.
items.cn: 自然哲学的作者用这个词指其中没有空气的空间。

items.en: English takes the word over in the sixteenth century, at first for that physical sense.
items.cn: 英语在十六世纪接收这个词，最初用于这层物理含义。

items.en: The suction cleaner of the early twentieth century borrows the name.
items.cn: 二十世纪早期的吸尘器借用了这个名字。

items.en: The figurative sense of a missing leader or of context-free thinking follows in modern usage.
items.cn: 失去领导者或脱离情境思考的引申义，在现代用法中随之出现。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the vac- family of emptiness, and the near-meaning group gives the empty and the full.
note.cn: 形近组收集表示「空」的 vac- 词族，近义组则给出空与满。

entries.definition: showing no thought
empty, not occupied
emptiness of mind or substance
amount of space, only the ending is close, the root is different
entries.definitionCN: 体积；只是词尾相近，词源不同

entries.definition: a completely empty space
an unfilled space
the state of having nothing inside
the state of being full

normalIntro.en: The word was borrowed whole from Latin as an emptied space; every later sense keeps that picture of nothing inside.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词整体借自拉丁语，是「空掉的空间」；此后每个义项都保留「里面什么都没有」的画面。

normal.en: The plural is vacuums in ordinary use and vacua in physics writing.
normal.cn: 日常复数写 vacuums，物理文字里则用 vacua。

normal.en: In a vacuum is the fixed phrase for acting without context.
normal.cn: in a vacuum 是「脱离情境」的固定说法。

normal.en: Vacuum cleaner is often shortened to vacuum, and then turned into a verb.
normal.cn: vacuum cleaner 常简称为 vacuum，再转成动词。

normal.en: A power vacuum appears when a weak government leaves a gap.
normal.cn: 权力真空出现在弱政府留下的空缺里。

normal.en: Vacuum shares its root with vacant and vacation.
normal.cn: vacuum 与 vacant、vacation 同根。

abstract.en: Picture a glass bell with a pipe on top, pulling the air out.
abstract.cn: 想象带抽气管的玻璃罩把空气抽走。

abstract.en: Hear the whistle of an old vacuum cleaner on a Sunday morning.
abstract.cn: 听周日早晨旧吸尘器的啸叫声。

abstract.en: See an empty desk where an old colleague used to sit.
abstract.cn: 看老同事曾坐过的那张空桌。

examples.en: The experiment took place in a vacuum, so there was no air resistance.
examples.cn: 这项实验在真空中进行，因此没有空气阻力。

examples.en: He vacuums the flat every Sunday.
examples.cn: 他每个周日都用吸尘器打扫公寓。

examples.en: The sudden resignation created a vacuum at the top of the firm.
examples.cn: 突然辞职在公司顶层造成了一片真空。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「挖空」——把里面的空气挖空了，就是真空。

root: 拉丁语 vacuus（空的）的中性名词形式 vacuum（空旷之处），整体借入英语；同根有 vacare（空着）

sensesIntro.en: One sealed empty space gives the physics sense, the suction machine, the gap left by a person, the verb of cleaning, and thought cut off from context.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个封闭的空空间给出物理义、抽气机器、失人留下的空缺、清扫动作，以及脱离情境的思考。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a glass bell emptied until feather and coin fall together.
core.cn: 核心意象：玻璃罩被抽空，羽毛与硬币一同落下。

branches.en: The lab branch: air removed so nothing slows the fall.
branches.cn: 实验室分支：空气被抽走，没有东西拖慢下落。

branches.en: The household branch: a machine that sucks dust.
branches.cn: 家务分支：吸走灰尘的机器。

branches.en: The gap branch: something important is missing.
branches.cn: 空缺分支：重要的东西不见了。

branches.en: The verb branch: running that machine over a floor.
branches.cn: 动词分支：用那台机器走过地面。

branches.en: The isolation branch: no surrounding influence at all.
branches.cn: 孤立分支：周围没有任何影响。

intro.en: A Latin noun taken over complete, so the Latin ending is still visible at the end.
intro.cn: 一个整体借入的拉丁名词，末尾的拉丁词尾至今清晰可见。

latinIntro.en: The root vacu- means empty in Latin; vacuus is the adjective and the neuter noun vacuum was borrowed unchanged.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 vacu- 意为空的；vacuus 是形容词，中性名词 vacuum 则原样借入英语。

items.example: The root carries the whole meaning.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根承载全部意义。

items.example: Vacuum is a Latin neuter noun.
items.exampleCN: vacuum 是拉丁语中性名词。
vacant 留在日常的房间上。

items.example: Vacation moved to the idea of free days.
items.exampleCN: vacation 转向空闲日子的概念。

items.example: Cleaner is the tool part of the compound.
items.exampleCN: cleaner 是复合词里的工具部分。
flask 出现在 vacuum flask 中。

definition_zh: 含糊的；模糊的；不明确的；隐约的
definition_en: not expressed or understood clearly, or seen only in an unclear outline
core_image: 隔着一层蒙雾的玻璃看外面走过来的人
scene: 雾很重，街对面有人在挥手，轮廓却像是被水泡开了一样，看不清到底是谁。His answer was so vague that nobody knew the date.
sceneCN: 这里 vague 是「含糊的、不明确的」（第 1 个义项：说法不清楚）；句意为他的回答太含糊，谁也没弄明白日期。隔着蒙雾看人的画面，正是这个词的核心。

derivatives.zh: 加 -ly 构成副词，义为「模糊地；含糊地」
加 -ness 构成名词，义为「含糊；模糊」
同根名词，义为「奇想；无常的变化」
同根动词，义为「离题；漫游」

senses.title: Not clearly stated
senses.definition: expressed in words that leave the meaning unclear
senses.definitionCN: 用让人无法确定含义的话表达
senses.example: The letter was vague about the exact time.
senses.exampleCN: 这封信对具体时间说得很含糊。
senses.why: A word that means wandering cannot pin anything down, so speech built on it leaves the listener without a fixed point.
senses.whyCN: 一个意为「游走」的词抓不住任何东西，因此由它构成的言语让听的人找不到落点。

senses.title: Without a clear shape
senses.definition: seen or remembered without clear outlines
senses.definitionCN: 看到或记得的东西轮廓不清
senses.example: A vague shape moved behind the curtain.
senses.exampleCN: 窗帘后面有个模糊的影子在动。
senses.why: An outline that will not settle is a wandering line, which is exactly what the Latin adjective describes.
senses.whyCN: 定不下来的轮廓就是一条游走的线，这正是那个拉丁形容词所描述的。

senses.title: An idea not fully formed
senses.definition: of a thought or feeling that is not yet worked out
senses.definitionCN: 形容想法或感觉尚未成形
senses.example: I had only a vague idea of what the job involved.
senses.exampleCN: 我对这份工作具体干什么只有个模糊的概念。
senses.why: Thoughts take shape gradually, and while the shape wanders it can only be described as unclear.
senses.whyCN: 想法是慢慢成形的，形状还在游走时，就只能说它不明确。

senses.title: Uncertain or absent-minded
senses.definition: of a person, not paying full attention or not sure of things
senses.definitionCN: 形容人不专注或对事情没把握
senses.example: She looked vaguely at the papers and said nothing.
senses.exampleCN: 她心不在焉地看了看那些文件，什么也没说。
senses.why: A mind that wanders off has no fixed object of attention, so the same adjective describes the person.
senses.whyCN: 心思走神的人没有固定的注意对象，于是同一个形容词也用来说人。

intro.en: A Latin adjective of wandering borrowed through French, with no live prefix or suffix inside it.
intro.cn: 一个意为「漫游」的拉丁形容词经法语借入，里面已没有仍在起作用的前后缀。

items.en: Vagus meant wandering, unsettled, or uncertain, and vagari meant to roam about.
items.cn: vagus 意为「漫游的、不定的、含糊的」，vagari 意为「四处游荡」。

items.en: The word entered French as vague, where the hard g softened before the final vowel.
items.cn: 这个词以 vague 的形式进入法语，尾元音前的 g 也随之软化。

items.en: English adopts the word in the sixteenth century for unclear statements.
items.cn: 英语在十六世纪采用这个词，指不清楚的说法。

items.en: The sense extends to outlines and memories that cannot be fixed.
items.cn: 词义扩展到无法定形的轮廓与记忆上。

items.en: Vaguely and vagueness become the common adverb and noun of the family.
items.cn: vaguely 与 vagueness 成为这一词族常用的副词与名词。

note.en: The look-alike group is the small vag- family, and the near-meaning group pairs unclear with plain and certain.
note.cn: 形近组是小小的 vag- 词族，近义组把模糊与清楚、确定相对照。

entries.definition: in an unclear way
lack of clarity
a wandering, unpredictable notion
the current fashion, only the spelling looks close, the root is different
entries.definitionCN: 风尚；只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: not easy to understand
open to more than one meaning
blurred and hard to make out
exact and clear

normalIntro.en: Hold on to wandering: a line that wanders has no clear edge, and neither does a vague answer.
normalIntro.cn: 抓住「游走」这个意思：游走的线没有清楚的边，含糊的回答也一样。

normal.en: Vague about something is the standard frame for being unclear.
normal.cn: vague about something 是表示「说不清」的标准框架。

normal.en: The adverb vaguely often means slightly, as in vaguely familiar.
normal.cn: 副词 vaguely 常表示「略微」，如 vaguely familiar。

normal.en: Vagueness is criticised in academic writing, where precision is expected.
normal.cn: 学术写作要求精确，所以常批评 vagueness。

normal.en: The comparative is vaguer, keeping the e in spelling.
normal.cn: 比较级是 vaguer，拼写里保留了 e。

normal.en: The same root appears in vagary, a wandering notion.
normal.cn: 同一词根见于 vagary，指游移不定的念头。

abstract.en: Picture a person waving across a street through heavy fog.
abstract.cn: 想象雾中街对面一个人在挥手。

abstract.en: Hear an instruction that says soon, without any hour.
abstract.cn: 听一句只说要「很快」却没有钟点的指示。

abstract.en: Try to recall a face from a dream and lose the eyes.
abstract.cn: 试着回忆梦里的一张脸，眼睛却总是想不起来。

examples.en: He was vague about where he had been that night.
examples.cn: 他对那晚去了哪里说得含含糊糊。

examples.en: I have only a vague memory of the house.
examples.cn: 我对那栋房子只有模糊的记忆。

examples.en: She waved vaguely toward the door and left.
examples.cn: 她心不在焉地朝门口挥了挥手就走了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「微格」——答案只剩微博那么一格，自然含含糊糊。

root: 拉丁语 vagus（漫游的、不定的）与 vagari（游荡），经法语 vague 进入英语

sensesIntro.en: Wandering yields lines that will not settle, and those lines give unclear speech, blurred outlines, unfinished ideas, and a mind that drifts.
sensesIntro.cn: 「漫游」带来定不下来的线条，而这些线条给出含糊的言语、模糊的轮廓、未完形的想法与飘走的注意力。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a figure waving through a misted window.
core.cn: 核心意象：隔着蒙雾的玻璃，一个人影在挥手。

branches.en: The words branch: an answer that will not commit.
branches.cn: 言辞分支：不肯明确的回答。

branches.en: The shape branch: a silhouette without an outline.
branches.cn: 轮廓分支：没有清晰边界的身影。

branches.en: The idea branch: a notion still without edges.
branches.cn: 念头分支：还没有边界的想法。

branches.en: The person branch: eyes that are not quite here.
branches.cn: 人身分支：眼神并不完全在此处。

branches.en: The clarity branch: what is missing is the plain outline of things.
branches.cn: 清晰分支：缺的正是事物清楚的样子。

intro.en: A borrowed adjective with no live prefix; its only everyday additions are -ly and -ness.
intro.cn: 一个借入的形容词，没有仍起作用的前缀；日常只在其后加 -ly 与 -ness。

latinIntro.en: Latin vagus, wandering, plus the verb vagari, to roam, share one root with no surviving prefix.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 vagus（漫游的）与动词 vagari（游荡）共用一个词根，没有留存下来的前缀。

items.exampleCN: 游走的线条总定不下来。

items.example: French gave the word its softer ending.
items.exampleCN: 法语给了这个词更柔和的词尾。
vaguely 描述不明确的方式。
vagueness 就是这一性质本身。

items.example: Divagate adds the idea of straying away.
A blur is what vague things look like.
items.exampleCN: 模糊之物看起来就是一团晕影。
